topics.inclusion_rule: Include studies that compress ultrasound tongue images (with or without lip images) into feature vectors for recognition, synthesis or articulatory mapping by DCT, PCA/EigenTongues, autoencoders or learned CNN encoders. Boundary: exclude contour-only tracking without a feature vector used downstream, raw-image end-to-end models with no stated feature stage, and reviews; count versions once.

Include studies that report recognition or reconstruction results on the Silent Speech Challenge archive (single speaker, silent TIMIT training, 100 WSJ0 5k test sentences) or that test on the same 100 SSC sentences with a new recording. Boundary: exclude studies that only cite the SSC, surveys that restate its numbers (kept in the pattern match), and studies on other ultrasound corpora; count versions once.

M06 and M12 reuse the published topic tables append-only; deciding priors for M06: Jaumard-Hakoun 2016 (speckle-denoising autoencoder on tongue ultrasound, cited by the target as [13]) and Ji 2018 (DAE baseline).

State of the art: the published tables already record the target's 6.17% as the best SSC WER under the closed 5k bigram; the later end-to-end SSC result (Kimura 2020, 20.5% with a 65k LM) is reported as the different-condition later work.
